quiz.title: Apache Spark
quiz.description: Distributed data processing with Apache Spark: RDDs, DataFrames, transformations vs actions, and cluster concepts.

questions.question_text: What is Apache Spark primarily used for?
What does RDD stand for in Spark?
What is the key difference between a Spark transformation and an action?
questions.option_a: Transformations are lazily evaluated and build a plan, while actions trigger actual computation
questions.option_b: Transformations run immediately and actions are lazy
questions.option_c: There is no difference between them
questions.correct_answer: Transformations are lazily evaluated and build a plan, while actions trigger actual computation

questions.question_text: Which Spark API provides a higher-level, table-like abstraction similar to a Pandas DataFrame?
What is a Spark 'driver program' responsible for?
questions.option_a: Coordinating the execution of a Spark application across the cluster
questions.correct_answer: Coordinating the execution of a Spark application across the cluster

questions.question_text: What does it mean that Spark performs 'in-memory' processing?
questions.option_a: It keeps intermediate data in RAM across operations to speed up computation compared to disk-based systems
questions.option_b: It never uses disk at all under any circumstance
questions.option_c: It only works on a single laptop
questions.option_d: It stores all data permanently in memory forever
questions.correct_answer: It keeps intermediate data in RAM across operations to speed up computation compared to disk-based systems

questions.option_a: A worker process that runs tasks and stores data for a Spark application
questions.option_b: A tool for editing SQL queries
questions.correct_answer: A worker process that runs tasks and stores data for a Spark application

questions.question_text: Which Spark component allows you to run SQL-like queries on structured data?
What is 'lazy evaluation' in Spark designed to enable?
questions.option_a: Optimizing the overall execution plan before any computation actually runs
questions.option_c: Forcing every line to execute immediately
questions.correct_answer: Optimizing the overall execution plan before any computation actually runs

questions.question_text: Which Spark module is designed for processing continuous streams of data?
Why is Spark often preferred over traditional single-machine tools for very large datasets?
questions.option_a: It distributes computation across many machines in a cluster, enabling horizontal scalability
questions.option_b: It can only process data smaller than 1MB
questions.option_c: It requires no cluster at all
questions.option_d: It only supports Java, not Python or Scala
questions.correct_answer: It distributes computation across many machines in a cluster, enabling horizontal scalability
